pages.title: Mall Goth Aesthetic Fashion
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Create alternative outfits in Mall Goth Aesthetic Fashion. Choose dark clothing, dramatic makeup, and bold accessories, then compare hairstyles that suit the finished look. Combine the available pieces into a complete mall-goth style for each character you dress.

pages.title: Cube Snake 2048
pages.creator: KridaX
pages.description: Grow a numbered chain around an arena in Cube Snake 2048. Collect loose cubes and consume players with smaller values, letting equal-numbered blocks merge when they meet. Build larger numbers while keeping the snake clear of opponents big enough to overpower it.

pages.title: Capybas
pages.creator: Play Mirror Games
pages.description: Locate hidden animals through deduction in Capybas. Place one capybara in each colored region, row, and column, ensuring that none touch even diagonally. Choose a difficulty and solve boards to earn coins for additional capybaras and visual themes.

pages.title: Obby: Pump Up Your Muscles! 1 per second
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Train a character inside a prison gym in Obby: Pump Up Your Muscles! 1 per second. Move between exercises such as push-ups, sit-ups, and pull-ups, using interactions and repeated training to build strength. Eat and continue exercising as the rookie develops through the ranks.

pages.title: Human Leap Evolution
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Guide a character through successive forms in Human Leap Evolution. Make choices during the jumping adventure to develop the hero from a caveman toward a futuristic warrior. Use the resulting power in enemy encounters as the character's evolution continues.

pages.title: Ultimate Brainrot Clicker
pages.creator: Colormind Games
pages.description: Generate Neural Coins by tapping in Ultimate Brainrot Clicker. Spend the currency on upgrades and increasingly unusual meme characters, expanding the collection as your output grows. Begin with Tralalero and keep developing the incremental system toward the later unlocks.

pages.title: Doomsday Tower Defense
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Protect a base in Doomsday Tower Defense. Place turrets along the undead approach, defeat zombies for coins, and improve the defensive line between attacks. Upgrade existing towers, buy additional ones, or sell a turret to reinvest its value in another position.

pages.title: Winter Wolf
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Guide a wolf through a snowy forest in Winter Wolf. Catch three sheep to collect their stars and gather the bones along the route while avoiding hunters. Collect all required items to activate the dark portal, using double jumps to reach the next section.

pages.title: Squirrel with a gun!
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Use gun recoil as movement in Squirrel with a gun! Wait for an enemy to line up, then tap to fire and launch the squirrel in the opposite direction. Take nuts from defeated opponents and work through slow-motion platforming challenges for further rewards.

pages.title: Jigsaw M
pages.creator: NovaSky
pages.description: Assemble pictures with a flexible piece count in Jigsaw M. Choose from the puzzle collection and adjust how many sections the selected image contains. Drag the pieces into place, using their shapes and picture details to restore the completed scene.

pages.title: Merge Numbers
pages.creator: RedFoc
pages.description: Slide equal values together in Merge Numbers. Swipe in one of four directions, or use the keyboard, to combine matching tiles into a higher number. Keep useful moves available as the board fills, since losing every possible move ends the game.

pages.title: Frog Byte
pages.creator: Catom Games
pages.description: Feed a hungry toad in Frog Byte. Click or touch to catch insects passing through the swamp, adding to the score with successful catches. Keep bombs out of the meal, since swallowing one ends the attempt instead of feeding the frog.

pages.title: Mr. Macagi Adventures
pages.creator: trezegames
pages.description: Cross forest and desert terrain in Mr. Macagi Adventures. Guide the explorer past monsters and through the hazards along each route. Four forest stages and four desert stages provide different settings for continuing the character's expedition.

pages.title: Train Drift
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Slide a locomotive through corners in Train Drift. Press left or right to tilt the train into a drifting state, using the directional keys or the matching screen areas. Keep the drifts going to build progress through the arcade racing challenge.

pages.title: Box Journey
pages.creator: basil
pages.description: Explore a pixel world as a moving box in Box Journey. Jump through the terrain, solve route puzzles, and look for hidden passages across the stages. Use directional controls to position the character for another landing and continue through the platforming adventure.

pages.title: Cat Girl Christmas Decor Game
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Help a feline heroine prepare a holiday celebration in Cat Girl Christmas Decor Game. Bake and decorate cakes and cookies, then work on the Christmas tree and house. Choose the festive details for each project before completing the character's preparations for her friends.

pages.title: 1010+ Block Puzzle
pages.creator: Massive Core
pages.description: Arrange shapes on a ten-by-ten board in 1010+ Block Puzzle. Fill rows and columns to remove them, keeping room for pieces arriving in the buffer. Store a piece when it cannot fit yet, and use boosters while exploring the two available modes.

pages.title: Football Kick 3D
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Carry the ball through a crowded match in Football Kick 3D. Slide to move, dribble past opponents, and tackle when possession changes. Score before the time limit expires while avoiding rival players trying to knock the footballer down.

pages.title: Matches Puzzle Game
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Rearrange sticks to satisfy each challenge in Matches Puzzle Game. Read the current question and move matchsticks into a configuration that answers it. Work through the collection of puzzles by checking how a small change alters the shape or expression in front of you.

pages.title: Wood Block Journey
pages.creator: SUN.STUDIO
pages.description: Place wooden shapes on a nine-by-nine board in Wood Block Journey. Complete rows, columns, or marked squares to clear the occupied cells. Clear several areas together for combo points and keep enough space for further shapes during the endless challenge.

pages.title: Extreme Car Drift
pages.creator: Inspector Studios
pages.description: Take a car onto the road for sliding turns in Extreme Car Drift. Use the driving controls to change the vehicle's direction and maintain movement through each drift. Practice handling the car along Drift Street as you explore the driving setting.

pages.title: Fantasy Triple Mahjong
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Find matching triples in Fantasy Triple Mahjong. Remove three identical tiles whose positions each have at least two neighboring sides open. Work through the remaining layout as each group disappears, finishing quickly to earn a stronger score.

pages.title: Fall Down Party
pages.creator: Firstpixel
pages.description: Stay on the correct picture in Fall Down Party. Watch the image shown by the doll and move onto a square displaying the same one before the round resolves. Keep a place in the arena while opponents compete for the surviving spaces.

pages.title: Pandjohng Solitaire
pages.creator: bestphysics
pages.description: Free pandas by clearing card layouts in Pandjohng Solitaire. Remove a card that is one rank above or below the active stock card, using jokers and bonuses when needed. Work through eighty stages, with another panda waiting to be released in each one.

pages.title: Happy farm make water pipes
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Bring irrigation to a vegetable plot in Happy farm make water pipes. Join the disconnected pipe sections so water can reach every field in the garden. Check the route through the whole arrangement before finishing the connection needed to supply the crops.

pages.title: Smash it 3D
pages.creator: GameBiz
pages.description: Time destructive strikes in Smash it 3D. Click to hit the target during activities that include breaking objects, chopping wood, and squashing cockroaches. Focus on the next object and land the required impact to continue the game's sequence of smashing tasks.

pages.title: Crazy Boy Escape From The Cave
pages.creator: GameArt
pages.description: Keep climbing away from enemies in Crazy Boy Escape From The Cave. Tap to jump and gain score while avoiding the creatures around the route. Continue through different cave settings, adjusting the next leap to escape another approaching threat.

pages.title: Galaxy Attack: Alien Shooter
pages.creator: Abigames Studio
pages.description: Defend Earth from alien formations in Galaxy Attack: Alien Shooter. Move the spacecraft through enemy waves and fire at the invaders while avoiding their attacks. Collect items to improve or change weapons as larger enemy groups appear in the battle.

pages.title: Fashion competition
pages.creator: tinyDream
pages.description: Prepare an outfit for a themed contest in Fashion competition. Choose makeup and clothing that suit the requested style, such as casual, romantic, or chic. Coordinate the pieces and finishing details to complete the character's look for the current competition.

pages.title: Zodiac Signs Memory
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Match astrological pictures in Zodiac Signs Memory. Flip cards to reveal their symbols and remember each position while searching for an identical partner. Clear all pairs before time expires to complete the level and take on another memory arrangement.

pages.title: GAPS
pages.creator: gamesmunch.com
pages.description: Send a ball through openings in GAPS. Watch the moving obstacles and tap or click when a passage lines up for the shot. Keep making the timed launches to travel farther through the course without striking a barrier.

pages.title: Cards Connect
pages.creator: bestphysics
pages.description: Clear playing-card pairs in Cards Connect. Select identical cards linked by a path of no more than three straight segments to remove them from the grid. Each match adds time, helping you finish the board across twelve different levels.

pages.title: Parkour Block 2
pages.creator: Poly Games
pages.description: Cross a sequence of jumping courses in Parkour Block 2. Move through the route, sprint when needed, and time leaps between the landing areas. Keyboard movement and a jump button control the character as the stages introduce more demanding platform arrangements.

pages.title: Panda Escape With Piggy
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Guide two companions through a forest in Panda Escape With Piggy. Use the separate directional controls for the panda and pig, jumping around obstacles and enemies. Double jumps help the pair cross the ten stages while keeping both characters out of danger.

pages.title: Billiard and Golf
pages.creator: Meyagames
pages.description: Send a ball into a cup on a pool-style table in Billiard and Golf. Swipe to choose a shot and account for how the ball will travel across the surface. Reach the hole accurately to complete the layout and open the next combined-sport puzzle.

pages.title: Moving Spheres
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Keep a ring airborne in Moving Spheres. Slide the large sphere beneath it to cushion each impact and redirect its movement. Prevent the ring from falling to the ground or striking the play area's sides while trying to extend the score.

pages.title: Orange Ball: BasketGo Puzzle
pages.creator: MURAT KYABISHEV
pages.description: Build a basketball solution from interactive objects in Orange Ball: BasketGo Puzzle. Trigger boxes, blocks, spinners, and escalators in an order that sends the ball toward the basket. Change the sequence or object properties when the first attempt misses the hoop.

pages.title: Endless Boundary
pages.creator: Simplegame
pages.description: Prepare heroes for a demonic onslaught in Endless Boundary. Create stronger equipment and send the fighters into the battles threatening their survival. Keep developing the available gear to support the party as the role-playing adventure introduces more powerful opponents.

pages.title: Endless Siege
pages.creator: RavalMatic
pages.description: Defend a fresh battlefield every day in Endless Siege. Place towers along the invaders' path and spend money on upgrades as successive waves arrive. Keep the kingdom standing for as long as possible, with the survival duration determining the final score.

pages.title: Christmas Drive
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Collect money during a festive drive in Christmas Drive. Control the car through the route and spend coins on new vehicles or improvements. Upgrade power and wheels in the shop to prepare the selected car for another attempt.

pages.title: Mr Fight
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Launch a fighter into opponents in Mr Fight. Drag to set the attack, with a longer pull producing a farther launch. Use the character's physical impact to defeat the enemies, looking for a trajectory that can clear several targets together.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Tale
pages.creator: Bubble Shooter
pages.description: Clear colored bubbles in Bubble Shooter Tale. Aim for groups of at least three and fulfill the specific objective assigned to each stage. Use power-ups when needed across seventy levels, earning enough points to pursue a three-star result.

pages.title: eBoy Fashion
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Give three princes a social-media-inspired makeover in eBoy Fashion. Choose outfits for Kristoff, Aladdin, and Eric, comparing clothing and accessories that fit the e-boy style. Complete a separate look for each character before finishing the group styling session.

pages.title: Sudoku Classic
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Fill a numerical grid in Sudoku Classic. Place digits one through nine so each row, column, and three-by-three box contains no repeats. Compare the values already present to work out a valid placement and continue until every empty square is resolved.

pages.title: Real Doctor Robot Animal Rescue
pages.creator: RealGame Studio
pages.description: Pick up animals in need of help in Real Doctor Robot Animal Rescue. Switch between a robot and ambulance forms to reach the animals and carry out rescue assignments. Use the vehicle and robot controls to complete the pickups around the mission area.

pages.title: Cute Teddy Bear Colors
pages.creator: MG Studio
pages.description: Give plush-character pictures a new palette in Cute Teddy Bear Colors. Choose colors and apply them to the bears, working through the details of the selected drawing. Combine the shades you want to complete the teddy bear's finished appearance.

pages.title: Onet Fruit Classic
pages.creator: RedFoc
pages.description: Clear produce pairs from a board in Onet Fruit Classic. Find identical fruit pictures and select a matching pair to remove it from the arrangement. Continue through the remaining tiles until all the fruit has been cleared from the field.

pages.title: Cook Up! Yummy Kitchen
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Prepare dishes from a collection of recipes in Cook Up! Yummy Kitchen. Follow the kitchen activities and use the available ingredients and tools to make each meal. Work through different cookbook choices as you develop the dishes in the cooking session.

pages.title: Vacation Time Jigsaw
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Rebuild holiday scenes in Vacation Time Jigsaw. Select one of twelve pictures and a layout with twenty-five, forty-nine, or one hundred pieces. Match the scattered sections by their edges and scene details until the vacation image is restored.

pages.title: Bus Simulator Ultimate
pages.creator: ideagames
pages.description: Carry passengers between cities in Bus Simulator Ultimate. Steer the coach through different road settings and bring its travelers to their destinations. Use the keyboard to control the bus while completing the transport routes through the surrounding landscapes.

pages.title: Car Wash Hidden
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Find picture pairs in Car Wash Hidden. Turn over tiles, compare their images, and remember the positions of cards already revealed. Clear all pairs across four levels while trying to complete each memory board in fewer moves.

pages.title: Word Cookies Online
pages.creator: fugames
pages.description: Form words from biscuit-shaped letters in Word Cookies Online. Swipe through the available alphabet cookies to create answers that fill the baking tray's crossword grid. Keep rearranging the letters in your mind to find the remaining words needed to complete the puzzle.

pages.title: Monsters And Friends Match 3
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Arrange matching creatures in Monsters And Friends Match 3. Make rows of at least three pieces of the same color to remove them and increase the score. Keep finding combinations while the left-side gauge runs down, since an empty meter ends the attempt.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Fruits Wheel
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Aim at a rotating fruit arrangement in Bubble Shooter Fruits Wheel. Fire matching bubbles into the wheel to remove its colored groups. Adjust each shot to the moving target, clearing the remaining fruit while the wheel changes the angle of the next opportunity.

pages.title: Donuts
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Make a batch of pastries in Donuts. Combine ingredients such as flour and sugar, mix the dough, and work through the rolling and shaping steps. Fry the prepared pieces and finish the cooking activity by completing the donuts' remaining preparation.

pages.title: Motor Home Travel Hidden
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Reveal traveling-vehicle pairs in Motor Home Travel Hidden. Flip tiles to expose their pictures and match identical images to remove them. Work through four memory levels and try to clear every arrangement with as few moves as possible.

pages.title: Hill Climb Tractor 2020
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Drive across uneven two-dimensional terrain in Hill Climb Tractor 2020. Use forward and reverse movement to carry the tractor through each hilly course. Complete stages to open more levels and improve the vehicle for the routes that follow.

pages.title: Spiders
pages.creator: GameOnHai
pages.description: Swing across overhead structures in Spiders. Hold to attach and travel through the air, then release to drop when another route opens. Avoid obstacles and collect gems along the way to unlock additional heroes for later attempts.

pages.title: Dont Explode the Ball
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Bounce between safe wall sections in Dont Explode the Ball. Tap to jump while avoiding the spikes covering the ceiling, floor, and changing parts of the side walls. Keep hitting clear spaces to continue the run without bursting the ball.

pages.title: Birds Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Assemble wildlife pictures in Birds Puzzle. Choose from six bird images and four layouts, with sixteen, thirty-six, sixty-four, or one hundred pieces. Reconnect the edges and feather details until the selected picture is complete.

pages.title: Angry Ninja
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Travel through a troll-filled world in Angry Ninja. Guide the fighter past hostile creatures while collecting treasure and useful bonuses. Pick up improvements along the journey to help with the dangers waiting farther through the route.

pages.title: Perface Christmas Anegel
pages.creator: igirlgames
pages.description: Style a festive character in Perface Christmas Anegel. Choose the clothing and beauty details for a Christmas angel, comparing the available pieces as the look develops. Complete the character's appearance with the outfit and finishing touches you want for the holiday.

pages.title: My Christmas Tree Decoration
pages.creator: Black Sheep Games
pages.description: Build a festive display in My Christmas Tree Decoration. Drag ornaments onto the tree and choose from lights, candy, presents, and other decorative pieces. Combine colors and placements until the tree has the holiday arrangement you want.

pages.title: Dockyard Tank Parking
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Maneuver a military vehicle into parking positions in Dockyard Tank Parking. Drive the tank around each dockside layout using the movement keys, checking its approach to the designated space. Switch the camera to inspect the surroundings before completing another parking stage.

pages.title: Stack And Merge
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Build higher values on stacked columns in Stack And Merge. Drag numbered circles onto towers and combine two equal values into a larger one. Discard unwanted circles to make room and work toward reaching eleven for a bonus.

pages.title: Over Load Passengers
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Operate a bus without exceeding its capacity in Over Load Passengers. Click to let people board or leave, watching how many passengers the vehicle is carrying. Keep the crowd manageable, since taking on too many people makes the overloaded bus explode.

pages.title: Santa Driver Coloring Book
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Color seasonal driving scenes in Santa Driver Coloring Book. Choose from ten pictures of Santa at the wheel and apply the colors you want. Add available shapes and finish the drawing's details before moving to another image in the collection.

pages.title: Candy Smash
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Clear groups of sweets in Candy Smash. Select at least two matching candies to remove them, opening gaps in the arrangement. When a level features animal targets, clear the pieces beneath them to bring the animals down to the ground.

pages.title: RC 125 Action Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Rebuild motorcycle pictures in RC 125 Action Puzzle. Pick one of six action images and choose a piece count from sixteen to one hundred. Match the scattered bike and background sections until the whole scene is connected again.

pages.title: Save Pizza
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Protect a meal from insects in Save Pizza. Click approaching cockroaches to remove them while leaving the olives untouched. Continue clearing the unwanted visitors as the endless defense brings more insects toward the pizza.

pages.title: Hyper Nostalgic Snake
pages.creator: Polygon Game Studio
pages.description: Grow a long trail in Hyper Nostalgic Snake. Use the arrow keys to steer toward food and extend the snake after each successful meal. Plan the next turn around the expanding body as you pursue more food across the playfield.

pages.title: Classic Match3
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Make matching gem groups in Classic Match3. Bring three or more identical jewels together to remove them from the board. Inspect the new arrangement after each clear and look for another combination that continues the gem-matching puzzle.

pages.title: BTS Flowers Coloring
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Paint floral illustrations in BTS Flowers Coloring. Choose a color for the brush and apply it to the drawing, building the flower's appearance section by section. Mix the available shades into your own arrangement before completing the picture.

pages.title: Time Jumper
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Jump past rotating clock hands in Time Jumper. Click to launch the character at a safe moment, watching how the hands cross its route. Continue timing the jumps to complete the required sequence without meeting a moving hand.

pages.title: Turbo Racer
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Drive through a high-speed route in Turbo Racer. Use the mouse to guide the car past obstacles, adjusting its position as another hazard approaches. Keep the vehicle clear of collisions to continue the racing attempt through the road ahead.

pages.title: Zero Collision
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Drive laps without crashing in Zero Collision. Move around opposing cars while accounting for hazards such as oil and frost on the track. Keep the vehicle clear of trouble as increasingly capable rivals make the route harder to negotiate.

pages.title: One Liner
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Trace a complete drawing with an uninterrupted stroke in One Liner. Move through the required shape without lifting the finger or mouse, planning the route before starting. Work through more than a hundred and twenty levels that demand different solutions to the single-line task.

pages.title: Dumb Ways to Die 2 The Games
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Keep familiar characters alive through short challenges in Dumb Ways to Die 2 The Games. React to each minigame's instruction before the available moment passes. Complete the rapid tasks and collect coins as the sequence tests another kind of response.

pages.title: Merge Balls
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Aim colored spheres into useful collisions in Merge Balls. Matching colors combine until they burst, providing more shooting opportunities. Use black balls carefully because they destroy other balls, including larger pieces that might otherwise help the next merge.

pages.title: Brain Teasers Colors Game
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Trigger a board-clearing sequence in Brain Teasers Colors Game. Burst dots so their effects reach the surrounding pieces and create a chain reaction. Plan which dot should begin the sequence, aiming to remove every remaining dot before advancing to another level.

pages.title: Knife Hit Colors
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Throw blades into rotating targets in Knife Hit Colors. Hit open spaces without striking existing knives or spikes, then unlock more knives from chests. Every fifth stage introduces a boss target with another throwing pattern to work around.

pages.title: Fruit Slice
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Cut through flying produce in Fruit Slice. Move the slicer across fruit as it enters the playfield, catching several pieces when their positions align. Avoid bombs mixed into the launches and keep slicing to build a higher result.

pages.title: Stickjet Challenge
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Fly a stick figure past hazards in Stickjet Challenge. Touch and hold to gain lift, adjusting the flight to pass obstacles along the route. Gather the stars placed through the course while keeping the character clear of the barriers ahead.

pages.title: Moto Hill Bike Racing
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Ride across hilly courses in Moto Hill Bike Racing. Control the motorcycle through slopes and jumps, balancing its movement to keep the bike intact. Complete stages within the game's chapters and move on to another off-road riding challenge.

pages.title: Cats Puzzle Time
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Put together feline portraits in Cats Puzzle Time. Select an easy, medium, or hard arrangement and reconnect the scattered pieces by their edges and picture details. The jigsaws have no time limit, letting you complete each cat scene at your chosen pace.

pages.title: Trading Simulator
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Explore simulated market operations in Trading Simulator. Watch a generated stock chart and choose a trade size before buying, selling, or closing a position. Observe how the changing virtual price affects the open trades during the simulation.

pages.title: NitroClash.io
pages.creator: FLOCASI
pages.description: Play an online football match in NitroClash.io. Guide a round character into the ball and push it toward the opposing goal, using boosts for faster movement. Bump rival players to contest possession and create an opening for the next scoring attempt.

pages.title: Fast Food Memory Challenge
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Find matching meal pictures in Fast Food Memory Challenge. Select a level mode and turn over cards to reveal the images hidden beneath them. Remember their positions, remove identical pairs, and clear the whole arrangement to finish the challenge.

pages.title: Zombie Drive
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Break through an infested city in Zombie Drive. Steer a modified car through groups of undead while limiting impacts with obstacles that damage the vehicle. Collect fuel and repair pickups along the road to keep the escape attempt moving.

pages.title: Baby Bear Jigsaw
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Reassemble young-animal pictures in Baby Bear Jigsaw. Choose one of six images and a layout containing sixteen, thirty-six, sixty-four, or one hundred pieces. Connect the scattered sections to restore the selected bear scene as quickly as you can.

pages.title: Sweet Candy Match
pages.creator: Freelance
pages.description: Make groups of matching sweets in Sweet Candy Match. Bring at least three identical candies together to clear pieces and increase the score. Continue finding combinations in the changing arrangement while the available time limits how long the matching run can last.

pages.title: Internet Hangman
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Guess technology-themed vocabulary in Internet Hangman. Select letters to uncover an internet-related word, using the revealed characters to narrow the possibilities. Think through the remaining choices before another incorrect guess brings the hanging figure closer to completion.

pages.title: Dinosaurs World Hidden Eggs
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Search prehistoric pictures in Dinosaurs World Hidden Eggs. Examine each scene and select the eggs concealed among the dinosaurs and surrounding details. Complete five timed levels by locating the remaining hidden objects before the countdown runs out.

pages.title: Jenner Sisters Buzzfeed Worth It
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Join Kylie and Kendall for a restaurant-themed outing in Jenner Sisters Buzzfeed Worth It. Help the sisters prepare for Steven Lim's pizza tour, choosing their looks for the visit. Complete the fashion choices before the pair set off to compare the featured pizzas.

pages.title: Word Search
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Find hidden vocabulary in Word Search. Choose among six languages and six word categories, then drag across the letters that form each requested word. Locate the full list as quickly as possible to complete the board.

pages.title: Tap Ninjas
pages.creator: Arwin Margallo
pages.description: Choose the correct rounded value in Tap Ninjas. Read the target number at the bottom and tap a ninja whose number rounds to it. Work through the choices at your own pace, since the arithmetic challenge has no countdown.

pages.title: Bunny Run
pages.creator: Happylander Ltd
pages.description: Guide a rabbit through a forest run in Bunny Run. Jump, duck, and swerve past the obstacles along the route while keeping the bunny moving forward. Collect gems to buy upgrades that support later attempts through the forest.

pages.title: Girls Fashion Competition
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Prepare two contestants for the runway in Girls Fashion Competition. Choose clothing and accessories for both characters, comparing how the pieces work as complete outfits. Finish each girl's appearance before sending the pair into the fashion contest.

pages.title: Shades of Pink
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Build a makeover around one color family in Shades of Pink. Choose makeup, hair details, and clothing that combine different pink tones into a complete look. Compare the shades as you work and finish the character's coordinated outfit.

pages.title: Shuigo 2
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Clear paired pictures from a tile layout in Shuigo 2. Select two identical tiles whose connecting path satisfies the game's bend limit. Removing a pair opens more space, so check the new arrangement for another available connection until the board is cleared.

pages.title: Kendall Hair Salon
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Run a styling session for three celebrity-inspired characters in Kendall Hair Salon. Work on Kendall, Gigi, and Kylie's hair, using the available salon options to change their looks. Complete each character's treatment and hairstyle before finishing the group's appointment.

pages.title: Bride and Bridesmaides Dress up
pages.creator: DariaGames.com
pages.description: Prepare a wedding party in Bride and Bridesmaides Dress up. Begin by choosing outfits for the two bridesmaids, comparing their clothing and accessories. Once their looks are finished, dress the bride to complete the three characters' preparations for the ceremony.
